lesson: A growth concept is not complete when the page feature is merged. It becomes reusable Powerhouse behavior only after the same product-led loop is projected into agent/chat inheritance, relevant skills, System Map, component registry, human docs, ledger and regression evidence.
prevention_rule: Future chats and agents must continue from this repository-backed loop and may not revert to contact-first or advice-only growth without measured evidence and same-lineage governance updates.
